text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS134, 4-1/2 Inch Blue Crab Door Knocker in Oiled Bronze

The 4-1/2 Inch Oiled Bronze Crab Door Knocker is a great addition to any home on the eastern coast. The blue crab door knocker has wonderful detailing, making it a top seller for Michael Healy Designs. It is 4-1/2 inches tall, 5-1/4 inches wide and has 7/8 inch mounting centers. It comes packaged with the hardware needed to surface mount it on both wood or metal doors.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Oiled Bronze Polished Brass and Brown Patina Nickel Silver

Features and Specifications of the Blue Crab Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 5-1/4"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 7/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-3/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
